No code. Just examples.

teachablemachine.withgoogle.com → Pose project
What just happened
Examples
Photos you labelled “left” and “right”
Train

Model
What it learned, stored as numbers
Predict

Nobody wrote the rule. The computer learned it from examples.
AI Explained · Ep 1
Then it got one wrong
YOU DID
Left hand up… then moved it over to the right side
THE MODEL SAID
“Right hand” — wrong
It only knows the examples it saw. In every “left” photo, the hand sat in one place. So it learned where the hand was, not which hand.
AI Explained · Ep 1
The fix: better examples, not new code
BEFORE
Left-hand photos with the hand in one spot
Moved hand → wrong
AFTER RETRAINING
Added photos with the hand moving across the frame
Moved hand → correct
We changed the data. The program stayed exactly the same.
AI Explained · Ep 1
Train → Learn → Predict
You just did what every modern AI does. Remember these three words.
WHAT IS WHAT
Now let’s name what you just saw.
AI · Machine learning · Neural networks · Generative AI · LLMs
WHAT IS WHAT · 1 OF 5
Artificial intelligence (AI)
Computer systems that do tasks that normally need human intelligence: recognising, predicting, deciding, creating.
Face unlock
Spam filter
Maps route
ChatGPT
The big umbrella. Older AI followed rules people wrote; most AI today learns from examples.
AI Explained · Ep 1
WHAT IS WHAT · 2 OF 5
Machine learning (ML)
A kind of AI that learns patterns from examples instead of following rules a person wrote.
WRITING RULES
if hand above head and on the left: say “Left”
MACHINE LEARNING
“Here are photos labelled Left and Right. Find the pattern.”
You saw it: Teachable Machine is machine learning.
AI Explained · Ep 1
WHAT IS WHAT · 3 OF 5
Neural network
An ML model made of neurons arranged in layers. Data goes in one side; an answer comes out the other.
Input layer
The data: your body points
Hidden layer
Combines the inputs to find patterns
Output layer
One neuron per answer: Left, Right
NEURON · each circle
A tiny calculator. It multiplies each input by a weight, adds them up, and passes the result on.
WEIGHT · each line
A number on the connection. Training finds the weights; recognizing uses them.
AI Explained · Ep 1
HOW IT WORKS · TRAINING
How training works
A weight is just a number on each line. Input × weight = how strongly that input pushes toward an answer.
The numbers on the lines are the weights

PHOTO 1 · LEFT HAND UP
Before training, the weights are random numbers.
Click to start.
1 · NUMBERS IN
Wrist up = 1, wrist down = 0.
Left wrist 1, right wrist 0
2 · MULTIPLY AND ADD
LEFT score = input × weight, added
1×0.2 + 0×0.5 = 0.2
RIGHT score
1×0.6 + 0×0.3 = 0.6
3 · COMPARE WITH LABEL
LEFT score = input × weight, added
1×0.2 + 0×0.5 = 0.2
RIGHT score
1×0.6 + 0×0.3 = 0.6
Guess RIGHT ✗ Label LEFT
4 · NUDGE THE WEIGHTS
Left wrist → LEFT: 0.2 → 0.3
Left wrist → RIGHT: 0.6 → 0.5
Toward the right answer goes up. Toward the wrong one goes down.

HOW IT WORKS · RECOGNIZING
How recognizing works
Training is over, so the weights are frozen. A new pose is multiplied by them, added up, and the biggest score wins.
Weights frozen: nothing changes now

RIGHT HAND UP
Training is over. These are the saved weights.
Click to run.
1 · NUMBERS IN
Left wrist 0, right wrist 1
2 · MULTIPLY AND ADD
LEFT score = input × weight, added
0×0.9 + 1×0.1 = 0.1
RIGHT score
0×0.1 + 1×0.9 = 0.9
3 · BIGGEST SCORE WINS
LEFT score = input × weight, added
0×0.9 + 1×0.1 = 0.1
RIGHT score
0×0.1 + 1×0.9 = 0.9
Answer: RIGHT
No weight changed.
NOW LEFT HAND UP
LEFT score = input × weight, added
1×0.9 + 0×0.1 = 0.9
RIGHT score
1×0.1 + 0×0.9 = 0.1
Answer: LEFT
Same weights, different input, different answer.
AI Explained · Ep 1 · simplified to 2 inputs; the real model uses many more numbers and layers
WHAT IS WHAT · 4 OF 5
Generative AI
AI that creates new content (text, images, audio, video, code) instead of only sorting things into labels.
TEACHABLE MACHINE
Picks a label
“Left” or “Right”
GENERATIVE AI
Makes something new
A paragraph, a picture, a song, a program
AI Explained · Ep 1
WHAT IS WHAT · 5 OF 5
Large language model (LLM)
A generative AI model trained on huge amounts of text to predict what comes next. ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini run on LLMs.
IT KEEPS GUESSING THE NEXT PIECE
The capital of India is New Delhi
“LARGE” MEANS
Billions of weights
